ordered_operations.selected_behavior: Resolve authored battle-global, caster-tag, caster-modifier, team-tag maximum and team-ratio sources from the typed context. For weighted-target scoring, default the missing AI tag exactly as authored, add servant damage carry when requested, round authored powers to nearest-even non-negative integers, then apply fixed-point powers. Evaluate MultiRange and factor folds with the same authored-order policy.
